channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 15
item.description:
29 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Players can no longer use the PT boat while restrained.
  • Mixing table UI now only updates the recipe list when ingredient availability changes, eliminating constant layout shuffling and improving UI stability.

Vehicles

  • Players can no longer use the PT boat while restrained.

World

  • Terrain now renders correctly when instancing is enabled, fixing missing patches.

UI & Crafting

  • Mixing table UI now includes toggle buttons for each recipe source, allowing you to enable or disable specific entries.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Mixing table UI now only updates the recipe list when ingredient availability changes, eliminating constant layout shuffling and improving UI stability.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 14
item.description:
137 development commits

Combat & Weapon Balancing

  • Nerfed damage of arrows, paintball projectiles, speargun spears, and shotgun slugs.
  • Increased UZI 9mm magazine capacity and fire rate for better combat performance.
  • Fixed turret viewmodel aim inconsistencies, improving targeting accuracy.

World & Environment Fixes

  • Cliffs now correctly remove heightmap mesh colliders when loading cached maps, eliminating collision glitches.
  • Players no longer get stuck on Christmas and Halloween lights, ensuring smooth navigation.
  • Fixed missing maps and pieces in Halloween and Xmas dungeons and corrected network group alignment for various map sizes.
  • Restored Frankenstein pet mobility by fixing a missing NavAgent component.

Gameplay Interactions & Mechanics

  • Item pickup UI now displays the total number of mushrooms owned after collection.
  • Frankenstein table can be used even when building is blocked.
  • Sail placement detection corrected so sails block appropriately whether lowered or raised.

Balance Adjustments

  • Removed admin cars, lowered snowball damage, reduced boat building block durability, cut ballista and static ballista seat counts, and decreased battering ram seats.
  • Monument blockers outside military tunnels now require explosives to break, matching other blockers.

Quality of Life & Economy

  • Fixed invisible or disconnected players blocking Halloween candy spawns.
  • Resolved marketplace terminal error that displayed a pending item notice after purchase.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Reduced the bonuses from Advanced, Pure, and Creamy/Milky teas (Advanced ~11% nerf, Pure/Milky ~18% nerf, Creamy ~20% nerf). Healing, Crafting Quality, and Rad Removal teas remain unchanged.
  • Fixed deep sea containers so they no longer spam tree‑spawn RPCs to all players when opened, removing related lag spikes.

Audio

  • Train sounds now play correctly, fixing missing audio from pooled train vehicles.
  • Metal detector swing now produces audible sound effects.
  • Ballista and catapult weapons now emit their respective firing sounds.

UI

  • Fixed a non‑interactable modal, restoring the ability to click through the affected UI window.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 13
item.description:
96 development commits

Survival & Movement

  • Sprint now consumes double calories and fluids by default (server.sprintmetabolismscale = 2).

Combat & Weapons

  • Shotguns fully reload all chambers when switching ammo types.
  • UZI 9mm now has separate ADS and recoil settings depending on stock deployment.
  • Handmade SMG damage increased from 20 to 21.

Building & Utilities

  • Distance flares no longer stay permanently off.
  • Blocks placed with a building plan now receive proper network IDs.

Vehicles & Map

  • Car spawning pre‑fills more engine slots (5‑slot engines start with 3 slots filled).
  • Middle‑mouse button can now drag map markers to reposition them.

Tattoo Customization

  • Tattoo system upgraded: brush size limited to 1‑5, zoom‑independent scaling, UV smoothing, and a two‑layer editing workflow with merging and fading, all synced server‑side.

Combat & Mechanics

  • Rear turret crosshair no longer sticks, restoring proper aiming
  • Fixed far‑shot and shell replay bugs, improving long‑range shooting consistency

UI & Controls

  • Tooltip bindings now display correct keys, fixing mismatched prompts
  • Steam Input glyphs corrected and cached, ensuring accurate controller button icons
